# Fixture job descriptions

One plain-text JD per file. Format: `.txt`, UTF-8, no frontmatter.
Filename is the fixture ID used across `expected-matches/` and
`expected-asset-traces/`.

**Example:** `mux-senior-pm-2026.txt` pairs with
`expected-matches/nathan-2026__mux-senior-pm-2026.json`.

## Populating

Phase 1 (#25) populates this directory with 10 JDs targeted at
Nathan's real search. Prefer JDs from Nathan's actual prospect list
(`matchline-prod` CRM data once it exists) — those are the most
accurate signal for match-accuracy scoring.

## Never commit

- JDs from recruiters under NDA.
- Private-listing content not meant for external redistribution.
  Paraphrase to capture the requirement structure if the original
  content is sensitive.
